description: PARTIAL SAVE: writes ONLY the 'Usage' field of TitlePublicConfigurationModel; all other v1/v2 fields stay untouched. Retention policy for the player's activity history (Usage). The engine keeps a rolling window of per-day records and folds everything older into monthly totals, then months of finished years into yearly totals — otherwise the per-day map grows forever inside the hottest document on the platform. WARNING: the fold is IRREVERSIBLE, per-day detail outside the window is gone for good. Do not lower DailyWindowDays below 400 without also lowering the analytics range cap: publisher analytics (DAU/WAU/MAU, retention cohorts, funnels) is computed lazily from those very per-day records, accepts ranges of up to 366 days, and needs 30 extra preceding days per requested day for MAU. Also holds SessionIdleTimeoutMinutes: how many minutes of silence end a session (default 30, the same rule Firebase/GA4 use, so the two reports stay comparable). The session boundary is decided by the SERVER from the player's last activity — the client's IsNewSession flag is not trusted for counting. Leave every field null unless you have a specific reason — the defaults (enabled, 400-day window, 30-minute session gap) are what the analytics horizon was sized against.

value.description: New value for the Usage field.

DailyWindowDays.description: How many recent days are kept per-day before being folded into monthly totals. Null = 400. Do not set below 400 unless you also lower the analytics range cap: publisher analytics reads these per-day records lazily, accepts a range of up to 366 days, and each requested day additionally needs the 30 preceding days for MAU.

MaxDaysFoldedPerPass.description: Max per-day records folded in a single login. Null = 400. Not a gameplay limit — just batch size; the remainder is folded on the next login.

RollupEnabled.description: Master switch for usage history rollup (days -> months -> years). Null = enabled. Turn off temporarily when you need full per-day history retained; the rollup is irreversible.

SessionIdleTimeoutMinutes.description: Minutes of inactivity that end a session. Null = 30 (same rule as Firebase/GA4, so the two reports stay comparable). The boundary is decided by the server from the player's last activity — the client's IsNewSession flag is not trusted for counting.
